args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip flops/sandals
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Insect repellent
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Power adapter (if needed)
- Waterproof phone case
- Small backpack for day trips
- Cash and credit cards
- Medications
- Travel insurance information
